cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. What did the manager say about the missing keys?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They might be in the drain. You locked up, didn't you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Is she asking everyone who locked up, or just me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just you. Someone saw you outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did they say what I was doing, or only where I was?

mechanism: A parrots an expert term incorrectly to sound informed while testing what evidence B has about an object A supplied.
confusable: D06 can be knowing secrecy; S04 requires visible unacknowledged misunderstanding.
comparison: Ownership evidence differs from meeting alarm information.
seedUse: Use D06-b narrowing what witness actually saw, not simply changing missing keys to another object.
